rootCauseFindings.finding: current builder filters source records by currentStandardUnitKey and queue target before primary classification; pilot P07/P08 demonstrate content-first L1 transfer cases
rootCauseFindings.impact: source-unit anchoring can suppress or misplace valid primary taxonomy paths

rootCauseFindings.finding: current classifier branches on keyword cues and has fallback L4 paths; pilot P16/P23/P24 demonstrate that a cue or nearest path cannot replace decisive strategy/path evidence
rootCauseFindings.impact: L3/L4 can be assigned without exact canonical fit; out-of-scope items can be forced or mishandled

rootCauseFindings.finding: current difficulty output is structuralScore/boolean evidence and lacks decisiveSolutionStep/difficultyReason as required by the new contract
rootCauseFindings.impact: bucket decisions are not reproducible from math evidence

rootCauseFindings.finding: current independent_recheck is invoked by the same build process and reruns the same classifier; it is not a separate B context
rootCauseFindings.impact: a wrong first-pass result can be re-packaged as RECHECK_PASS

rootCauseFindings.finding: apply/validation receipts contained writer-supplied parity claims rather than recomputing every protected-field and runtime comparison
rootCauseFindings.impact: fake validation can mask source or sidecar drift

rootCauseFindings.finding: two original M3 source records have decisive M2-07/solid-geometry concepts while living in M3 source scope
rootCauseFindings.impact: must remain explicit foundation defect candidates; source JS must not be changed
